title.narrative: Sustainable Projects in the Textile and Garment Sector

description.narrative: ADB will provide a 5-year senior unsecured term loan to Eastern Bank of up to $20 million. The proceeds will be used to finance socially and environmentally sustainable projects in the textile and garment sector. In particular, the proposed loan will finance the construction or expansion of textile and garment factories that meet the high structural, fire, and electrical safety standards required by the accord or the alliance. All sub-borrowers will be required to consider energy efficiency and be encouraged to select energy efficient designs and equipment for the sub-projects.
